newsitem.title: USA: SmithKline Beecham to donate drugs for world's needy.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline Beecham to donate drugs for world's needy.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Plc said on Sunday it would work with two humanitarian agencies to provide drugs and medicines to nearly half a million needy people in more than 35 countries.
The $15 million pilot program will enable Project HOPE and AmeriCares, two international aid organizations, to "order" from SmithKline Beecham the medications they need, based on in-country surveys.
"Our primary intent is to get the right product to the right place at the right time, to the people who need it most," said Jerry Karabelas, executive vice president of SmithKline Beecham.

Under the program, SmithKline Beecham will provide $7.5 million in drugs to both Project HOPE and AmeriCares in April, July and October, which will be distributed by the groups' staffs and partner agencies already in place.
Some of the first countries to benefit from the new program include Armenia, Bulgaria, China, Czech Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, Philippines and Poland.
